name: Sample Chart Profiles
note: Real, publicly documented birth data for well-known figures, for the app's sample-chart browsing feature. Every entry here has a genuinely sourced birth TIME (not just date/place) - 20 names from the original confirmed list were excluded entirely because no reliably documented birth time could be found (see the project owner's explicit decision on this: exclude rather than show an approximate/guessed chart). time_confidence 'high' = birth certificate or equivalent official record; 'medium' = biography/family statement/reputable astrology database citing a specific source. source_note on each entry explains where the claimed time comes from and, where relevant, flags a competing claim found during research - see each entry's own note. Not yet reviewed by the project owner - drafted by research agents using live web search, cross-checked for internally consistent sourcing only. Each profile also carries a chart_description field - a short, computed-fact-based summary (ascendant, Moon, Atmakaraka, exalted/debilitated planets, lagna lord placement, and any triggered classical yogas) generated directly from this project's own engine, not freehand commentary.

FLAG: this conflicts with other accounts -- Swami Nikhilananda's 1975 biography gives 6:49 AM ('a few minutes after sunrise'), and at least one other reference lists 6:45 AM as 'recorded.' All three cluster tightly around sunrise on Makar Sankranti day, but they are not identical. Graded medium (not high) because of this real conflict between named sources; a human should double-check before treating 6:33 as definitive.
